title: The h-cohomology of the perfected structure sheaf is the colimit of the cohomologies of the structure sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The proposition computes the h-cohomology of the perfected structure sheaf of a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme over F_p as the colimit of the cohomologies of the structure sheaf (statement lines 23707-23717). The proof (proof lines 23719-23746) identifies the sheaf with the perfection, uses the essential-image statement to see that it equals its own h-pushforward, applies Leray to pass to fppf cohomology, and computes the colimit there. H2: one identification plus one Leray computation.
